text:
emma: Heads-up: several example apps started failing in CI after the latest typegen publish. minimal repro points to client default options being undefined in browser bundles.
noah: Can you paste the CI stack?
emma: truncated:
```
TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'timeout')
  at new Client (dist/sdk/client.js:54:22)
  at init (dist/app.js:12:5)
```
rachel: I pulled the regen diff. typegen v0.9.0 shows: "refactor: consolidate client defaults; reorder exports for perf" — no semver note.
ben: If defaults moved into a top-level init that used side-effect imports, bundlers like esbuild can drop them if ordering changes. That would explain runtime missing defaults.
noah: examples commonly have "@redwood/typegen": "^0.8.0" so npm may have pulled 0.9.0 as a patch in some lockfiles. we need to prevent surprise upgrades.
emma: immediate mitigation: pin typegen in example package.jsons and rerun CI. I'll open a patch.
release-bot: published typegen@0.9.0 at 1876020000. changelog: "refactor: consolidate client defaults; reorder exports for perf".
rachel: follow-up actions: (1) revert the runtime-default relocation and publish a safe patch; (2) add a postpublish smoke that builds canonical examples with esbuild; (3) require a semver-impact line in changelogs.
ben: also recommend publishing potentially-breaking refactors under dist-tag "next" until smoke tests pass, so caret ranges don't auto-upgrade consumers.
noah: I'll make a GH Action that runs `yarn --frozen-lockfile` and `yarn build` for each example on publish. quick PR incoming.
emma: PR to pin examples: https://github.com/redwood-inference/examples/pull/789 pinned to 0.8.0 — CI queued.
rachel: filing a release playbook update to add a checklist entry: "Run browser bundle smoke with esbuild and webpack" and "Changelog: Semver impact".
emma: CI green after pin. Will monitor while revert PR is prepared. Thanks team.
noah: great triage — let's roll these changes into the typegen release workflow so this doesn't repeat.
